method: agmi at-rest edits T1 to T10, verdict words per draft-khandelwal-bmwg-agent-memory-integrity

attacks.name: tamper
attacks.description: Alter the payload of a stored entry without touching its links.

attacks.name: truncate
attacks.description: Remove the most recent entries from the tail of the store.

attacks.name: delete_middle
attacks.description: Remove one interior entry, leaving a gap in the sequence.

attacks.name: reorder
attacks.description: Exchange two entries so events appear in the wrong order.

attacks.name: forge
attacks.description: Append a fabricated entry crafted to look authentic.

attacks.name: cross_replay
attacks.description: Replay a genuine record from another context onto this one, keeping the victim's identity.

attacks.name: rollback_replay
attacks.description: Replay an older genuine record of this context over its newest, rolling state back.

attacks.name: metadata_tamper
attacks.description: Alter a record's owner/source/timestamp without changing its content.

attacks.name: snapshot_rollback
attacks.description: Restore an older complete copy of the store, taken before the newest genuine record was written.

attacks.name: erase_resurrect
attacks.description: Restore a copy of the store taken before the tool erased a record through its own API.

snapshot_rollback.detail: the older copy opened as current; the newest genuine record is gone without an error

erase_resurrect.detail: the restored copy opened as current; the record the store had erased is served again without an error

rows.measured_on: nonrtric-plt-a1policymanagementservice 2.13.0 (file store) with two OSC_2.1.0 A1 simulators
